scope: Future H2 qualification and, only after separate authorization, same-panel H4; no formal launch in this revision

h1_runtime_contract.inherit: verified model implementation, loaders, numerical precision, schedule, video format and offline resources

admission.idle_requires: no resident compute process, near-baseline VRAM, no active utilization; unknown queries fail closed
admission.vram: H1 peak allocated 43.142 GiB is a reference, not total reserved memory; preserve original single-GPU working set and safety margin
admission.host: recheck MemAvailable, CPU load and disk; budget simultaneous model CPU reconstruction and text encoding before raising worker count; stage worker loading to limit transient RAM and I/O
admission.fewer_than_three_idle: use only actually admitted free cards and report lower concurrency; never occupy resident users to meet target

assignment.unit: prompt-seed pair; both T50 and S5 assigned to same physical GPU
assignment.method: balance each library across deterministic shards; bounded blocks and balanced T/S block order to reduce reloads and order confounding
assignment.evaluation: use only admitted cards without a simultaneous generation worker; each video is scored only for its library metrics

conflict_policy.action: stop only own affected worker, retain committed valid outputs, release GPU, recheck free candidates before retry; no seed/prompt substitutions
conflict_policy.retry_unit: if moving a partially completed pair, regenerate the pair on the destination GPU; preserve valid previous attempt as superseded and account for its cost; predeclared placement rule, never select by score
conflict_policy.duplicate_prevention: task claiming, output identity checks and atomic commits required before H2 launch

implementation_gate: H1 smoke scripts are GPU-6-specific and are not a formal multi-GPU launcher; implement and validate H2 sharding, admission and resume logic within future authorized H2 preparation before full dispatch
